mainEntity.name: Will I regain the weight when I stop GLP-1?

acceptedAnswer.text: Weight regain is common when a GLP-1 is used alone and then stopped. That is exactly why it is used here inside a plan that protects muscle, rebuilds nutrition and metabolism, and prepares a deliberate taper, so the loss can hold rather than rebound.

mainEntity.name: What are the side effects of GLP-1 injections?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common side effects are nausea, reduced appetite, and digestive changes, usually strongest after a dose increase. Starting low, titrating slowly to your response, and pairing the medication with nutrition support keeps most of these manageable.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to be on GLP-1 forever?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. For some patients it is a longer-term tool; for others it is a bridge while the underlying metabolic and hormonal drivers are corrected. The plan includes how you would taper and hold your progress, not just how you start.
